blurb: Exclusive Adventure Awaits: Dive into a worry-free private combo adventure! Secure your spot for an exhilarating journey exploring San Francisco's attractions, Muir Woods' ancient redwoods, & the charming Sausalito in a 4-hour private guided tour. Your adventure kicks off with a complimentary pickup at your San Francisco hotel. Cross the iconic Golden Gate Bridge en route to Muir Woods National Monument, where you'll marvel at ancient redwoods on trails for all levels. Enjoy local treats at the Visitor Center. After Muir Woods, visit the Muir Beach Overlook to watch the Pacific Ocean unfold along scenic Highway 1. Next, discover Sausalito's waterfront charm with breathtaking Bay and Alcatraz views. Explore boutique shops, waterfront dining, the yacht harbor, local art galleries, and the charming houseboat community.The drive back to San Francisco includes photo stops at the Golden Gate Bridge, concluding with a drop-off at your hotel. Book your adventure now and let the magic unfold!
